chunks.en: What kind of classes do you have?
accept: What kinds of classes do you have?
chunks.note: 想知道一個地方開哪些課時問。What kind of + 複數名詞 = 哪一類的……

distractors.text: What kind classes do you have?
What kind of classes you have?
What kind of classes do you has?

chunks.en: I'm hoping to find an office job.
chunks.zh: 我希望能找到辦公室的工作。
accept: I hope to find an office job.
chunks.note: 說自己的目標。I'm hoping to + 動詞原形 = 我希望能……，比 I want to 委婉。

distractors.text: I'm hoping find an office job.
I'm hoping to find a office job.
I'm hope to find an office job.

chunks.en: Do I have to be a member?
chunks.note: 問是不是一定要怎樣。have to 後面接動詞原形，be 不能省。

distractors.text: Do I has to be a member?
Do I have to a member?
Do I have to be member?

chunks.en: Can I just write my email?
chunks.note: 表格不想全部填時問。just = 只要；can 後面接動詞原形。

distractors.text: Can I just writing my email?
Can I just to write my email?
Can I just write me email?

chunks.en: I'm going to start in September.
accept: I am going to start in September.
chunks.note: 說已經決定的計畫：be going to + 動詞原形。月份前用 in。

distractors.text: I'm going to starting in September.
I going to start in September.
I'm going to start on September.

chunks.note: 問課從什麼時候開始。begin = start；do 放在 classes 前面。

distractors.text: When classes do begin?
When do classes begins?
When does classes begin?

chunks.note: 用 So……? 確認自己算得對不對。主詞 it 是單數，ends 要加 s。

distractors.text: So it end in December?
So it ends on December?
So it ends in Desember?

chunks.en: Are there classes during the day?
accept: Are there any classes during the day?
chunks.note: 問白天有沒有課。Are there + 複數名詞……? = 有……嗎？

distractors.text: Is there classes during the day?
Are there classes during day?
Are there class during the day?

chunks.note: 對方太小聲或旁邊太吵時說。can't = cannot，後面接動詞原形。

distractors.text: Sorry, I can't hearing you.
Sorry, I don't can hear you.
Sorry, I can't here you.

chunks.zh: 可以再示範一次給我看嗎？
chunks.note: 沒看懂示範時，請對方再做一次。show me = 做給我看。

distractors.text: Can you show again me?
Can you show I again?
Can you shows me again?

chunks.note: 問多常做一件事用 How often……？回答用 always、sometimes 這類字。

distractors.text: How often you practice?
How often do you practices?
How many often do you practice?

chunks.en: I usually study a few nights a week.
chunks.zh: 我通常一個禮拜有幾個晚上會唸書。
chunks.note: usually 這類頻率副詞放在一般動詞前面。a few = 幾個。

distractors.text: I study usually a few nights a week.
I usually study a few night a week.
I usually study few nights a week.

chunks.en: It's hard, but I'm learning a lot.
chunks.note: 說一件事很難、但很有收穫。a lot = 很多，放在句尾。

distractors.text: It's hard, but I'm learning a lots.
It's hard, but I learning a lot.
It's hard, but I'm learn a lot.

chunks.zh: 也許我們可以一起練習。
chunks.note: 提議一起做某件事。can 後面接動詞原形，together 放句尾。

distractors.text: Maybe we can practicing together.
Maybe we can to practice together.
Maybe can we practice together.

pairs.note: 單獨念的時候，can 和 can't 母音一樣，要聽字尾：can't 最後舌尖頂住上排牙齒後面、停一下，聲音像被切斷；can 則是 n 的鼻音收尾。放進句子裡，can 通常念得又輕又短，像「肯」，can't 還是念得清楚有重音。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Welcome to our community center!
scene.zh: 歡迎來到我們的社區中心！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What kind of classes do you have?
scene.zh: 你們有開哪些課？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Cooking, dance, and a computer course.
scene.zh: 有烹飪、跳舞，還有電腦課。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm hoping to find an office job.
scene.zh: 我希望能找到辦公室的工作。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then try the computer course. Students really like it.
scene.zh: 那就去上電腦課吧。學生都很喜歡。

fills.en: Do I have to ___ a member?
fills.note: have to 後面接動詞原形 be。

fills.en: Adults can ___ the basic class for free.
fills.zh: 成人可以免費參加基礎班。
fills.note: can 後面接動詞原形 join。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! Do you want to register for the basic class?
scene.zh: 嗨！你要報名基礎班嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do I have to be a member?
scene.zh: 一定要是會員嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, but it's free to join. Write your name and address here.
scene.zh: 要，不過加入是免費的。在這裡寫你的名字和地址。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can I just write my email?
scene.zh: 只寫電子郵件可以嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure, no problem. You're a member now!
scene.zh: 可以啊，沒問題。你現在是會員了！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We have summer classes in July and August.
scene.zh: 我們七月和八月有開暑期班。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: They're almost over. So, what's your plan?
scene.zh: 快結束了。那你有什麼打算？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm going to start in September.
scene.zh: 我打算九月開始上。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. The new course starts next week.
scene.zh: 很好。新的課程下禮拜就開始。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: When do classes begin?
scene.zh: 什麼時候開課？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Next Monday, at seven in the evening.
scene.zh: 下禮拜一，晚上七點。

passages.title: Basic Computer Class for Adults
lines: No classes in July and August.
Free for members. Joining is free, too!

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The course is four months. It starts in September.
scene.zh: 這門課上四個月，九月開始。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So it ends in December?
scene.zh: 所以是十二月結束？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. Classes are Monday and Thursday evenings.
scene.zh: 對。每個禮拜一和禮拜四晚上上課。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Are there classes during the day?
scene.zh: 白天有課嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, starting in October. And there are seats available.
scene.zh: 有，十月開始。而且現在還有空位。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: There's a free workshop in November, too.
scene.zh: 十一月還有一個免費的工作坊。

options.en: He is sleeping at his desk.
He is eating at his desk.
They are listening to the teacher.

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, please listen and look at the screen.
scene.zh: 好，請注意聽，看螢幕。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sorry, I can't hear you.
scene.zh: 不好意思，我聽不到。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry! Put your hand on the mouse, like this.
scene.zh: 抱歉！把手放在滑鼠上，像這樣。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can you show me again?
scene.zh: 可以再示範一次給我看嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. Now find the letter A on the keyboard.
scene.zh: 好啊。現在在鍵盤上找到字母 A。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The instructions are on your desk, too.
scene.zh: 操作說明也放在你的桌上。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Nice work! Do you practice at home?
scene.zh: 做得不錯喔！你在家有練習嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I usually study a few nights a week.
scene.zh: 我通常一個禮拜有幾個晚上會唸書。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good for you! I'm learning Chinese, so we're both students.
scene.zh: 很好啊！我在學中文，所以我們兩個都是學生。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How often do you practice?
scene.zh: 你多久練習一次？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Well, sometimes every day, sometimes never!
scene.zh: 嗯，有時候每天練，有時候完全沒練！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: My classmates always practice. Not me!
scene.zh: 我的同學都很認真練習，我就不是了！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, how's the computer class going?
scene.zh: 那電腦課上得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: It's hard, but I'm learning a lot.
scene.zh: 很難，但我學到很多。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Is that your homework?
scene.zh: 那是你的作業嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Ten exercises and a test!
scene.zh: 十題練習題，還有考試！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'm bad with computers. Can you teach me?
scene.zh: 我對電腦很不在行。你可以教我嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Maybe we can practice together.
scene.zh: 也許我們可以一起練習。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good idea! Let's talk over coffee.
scene.zh: 好主意！我們邊喝咖啡邊聊吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's all for today. Any questions?
scene.zh: 今天就上到這裡。有問題嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can you show me again?
scene.zh: 可以再示範一次給我看嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. Put your hand on the mouse, like this. See?
scene.zh: 好啊。把手放在滑鼠上，像這樣。懂了嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, how's the class going for you?
scene.zh: 那你覺得這門課上得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: It's hard, but I'm learning a lot.
scene.zh: 很難，但我學到很多。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You're doing great. Do you practice at home?
scene.zh: 你表現得很好。你在家有練習嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I usually study a few nights a week.
scene.zh: 我通常一個禮拜有幾個晚上會唸書。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good! Why are you taking this course?
scene.zh: 很好！你為什麼來上這門課？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm hoping to find an office job.
scene.zh: 我希望能找到辦公室的工作。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then take my next course. It's all about office work.
scene.zh: 那來上我的下一門課吧，內容都是辦公室的工作。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: When do classes begin?
scene.zh: 什麼時候開課？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: In November. It's six weeks, two nights a week.
scene.zh: 十一月。上六個禮拜，一個禮拜兩個晚上。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So it ends in December?
scene.zh: 所以是十二月結束？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right. Write your name and phone number here.
scene.zh: 對。在這裡寫你的名字和電話。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can I just write my email?
scene.zh: 只寫電子郵件可以嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. And look, here's Ben!
scene.zh: 可以。你看，Ben 來了！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! I'm going to take that course, too. We'll be classmates!
scene.zh: 嗨！我也要去上那門課。我們會是同學喔！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Maybe we can practice together.
scene.zh: 也許我們可以一起練習。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good idea! Let's start next week.
scene.zh: 好主意！我們下禮拜就開始。
